approval_required_for: Implementation or use of planned_tool.exact_board_compile_plan_reconciler when the framework lacks an authority-preserving reconciler.
Any generated verification-template repair beyond an evidence-bound, semantics-preserving declaration or compile-order correction.
Any architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, checkpoint, stimulus, golden, testbench-contract, exact-wrapper, or source-closure change.

consumes: current exact board source-closure and Vivado-facts bindings
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the board layer blocked; report the missing provenance fields and implement the planned capability before any source or RTL edit. Do not reopen operator leaves or the connected kernel and do not run a legacy fallback or unauthorized compile.
produces: raw compiler diagnostic with absolute path, line, column, and identifier
bounded source excerpt with declaration or instance context
ordered VCS source list, include directories, defines, language modes, executable identity, and authority references
executable_actions.rationale: The current evidence names the undeclared identifier and source line but does not provide the complete provenance contract required for a safe repair. The action_grounding_registry has no exact_board_vcs_compile_provenance role, so planned_tool.vcs_compile_diagnostic_source_provenance declares the implementation gap. It must read the preserved current log and manifests, not rerun an unauthorized compile and not edit a candidate module.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep case_axi_ddr_interface and all dependent simulation gates blocked. Do not substitute a wrapper, guess an executable, or proceed to functional simulation; return the unresolved authority/reference mismatch for bounded approval or capability repair.
produces: hash-bound manifest and command authorization report
executable_actions.rationale: The direct current checker failure is an identity and compile-plan binding failure. Regenerate or reconcile only the consuming board simulation manifest and canonical VCS compile plan from the exact board identity, selected simulation source closure, compute-slot ABI, timing contract, Vivado export facts, and authorized tool profile. The exact user wrapper and source hashes must remain unchanged; ambiguous executable or authority selection must stop for bounded approval rather than guessing.

consumes: exact current generated board testbench source excerpt
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not apply a speculative declaration or value. Keep the current layer blocked and route the unresolved ownership or contract issue back to provenance/compile-plan repair; do not reopen lower layers.
produces: bounded source diff and ownership record
updated generated-source hash and compile-plan candidate
executable_actions.rationale: If and only if the accepted provenance report assigns ACTIVATION_AXI_BEATS_PER_TOKEN at spatialacc_exact_board_multilayer_tb.sv:2578 to the generated verification harness or compile plan and identifies the exact declaration/order defect, apply the smallest semantics-preserving repair. Do not infer its value, patch accelerator RTL, alter model data, change expected output generation, or change the testbench contract. Recompute only the affected generated-source and repair-manifest hashes.

consumes: independent target-model reference for the same checkpoint and stimulus
immutable numeric comparison policy and tolerance
executable_actions.on_failure: Remain in board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system repair. If compilation fails, consume the fresh diagnostic with the provenance capability; if runtime begins and fails, use the current boundary trace and failure localization to repair the earliest current-layer owner. Do not promote and do not reopen a lower layer unless the trace explicitly contains the required hash-bound contradiction evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: After the exact compile plan and any evidence-bound harness repair pass static checks, rerun the failed board layer using the exact sample wrapper and current immutable model artifacts. The first runtime-debug operation is a current-layer targeted replay with boundary monitors and CCTG trace. Preserve elastic variable-latency token-pipeline semantics, distinguish AXI/prefetch progress from output/lifecycle-frontier progress, and localize the earliest causal boundary before any hardware repair. Downstream gates are dependency-ordered and cannot promote independently.

consumes: candidate repair decision and action audit
repair patch and contract-preservation report if produced
latest Stage7 real-tool and semantic-evidence reports
sacg_memory_truth open retry requests and active contamination barriers
executable_actions.on_failure: Preserve the active barriers and open retry requests, mark the repair attempt incomplete, and do not let any repair artifact be consumed as a validated design input or enable promotion.
produces: SACG retry transition record with consumed and produced artifact hashes
updated trust-barrier disposition for artifact.stage7.verification_result and artifact.stage8.repair_plan
executable_actions.rationale: Persist the bounded repair attempt and its fresh response so the six current open retry requests and active contamination barriers are neither silently discarded nor mistaken for validated inputs. A passing new hash-bound Stage7 transition may supersede the rejected candidate artifacts; until then, all rejected Stage7 and Stage8 outputs remain planning/debug evidence only.

observations: The earliest current-layer deterministic blocker is real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface: the simulation manifest does not bind the current board identity, the compile authority and ordered-command authority references do not bind the exact Vivado export facts, and the selected executables are not authorized by the current tool profile or cited export.

The exact user-supplied sample wrapper identity itself is reported pass, including exact wrapper status, source-closure binding, simulation/source hash agreement, AXI interface hash, compute-slot ABI hash, timing contract hash, and Vivado-facts hash. The failure is therefore in the consuming simulation manifest/compile plan, not evidence that the wrapper may be replaced.

The preserved VCS log identifies ACTIVATION_AXI_BEATS_PER_TOKEN at spatialacc_exact_board_multilayer_tb.sv line 2578, but the prior repair execution correctly remained blocked because it did not preserve the bounded source excerpt, declaration/instance context, and exact ordered compile options needed to distinguish a missing declaration from compile ordering, inclusion, language-mode, or ownership error. This is not sufficient evidence for a speculative source patch.

The VCS compile failed before simulation. Dynamic simulation.log, hierarchy, progress, AXI protocol, pipeline-overlap, runtime-loader, and semantic-evidence reports are absent; termination is indeterminate and must not be classified as a hardware deadlock, liveness failure, output-frontier failure, or protocol failure.

A boundary-trace artifact is present and marked trace_ready, but it has no failed boundary records and the board-to-lower-layer contradiction evidence is explicitly insufficient. It cannot establish a board pass or contradict the certified lower layers.

The hierarchical learning context supplies live hash-validated operator-leaf and connected single-layer certificates. It reports no current contradiction, and its connected-kernel certificate requires elastic rate-insensitive timing with boundary order and cross-token overlap rather than same-cycle completion. Leaf modules and the connected kernel must remain reusable and must not be reopened.

The target-model expected-output source is target_model_inference and a large DUT binding hash set is present, but board numeric comparison was not run and the binding manifest is not proof of executed consumption. A board pass still requires the same checkpoint and stimulus, complete target-checkpoint tensor catalog, independent reference inference, immutable numeric policy, semantic testbench hashes, and an executed loader report for all required Transformer-block tensors.

sacg_memory_truth reports 16 active contamination barriers, six open retry requests (retry_request.0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, and .0144), and zero open backtrack requests for this scope. Rejected Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only until a new hash-bound retry transition passes. The conditional specialist router returned no_split; that absence cannot replace deterministic evidence.
proposed_actions: Implement or execute the missing provenance capability against preserved current artifacts only; do not perform an unchanged-source unauthorized VCS replay.

Reconcile the board simulation manifest and canonical VCS compile plan from the exact sample-project identity, current Vivado export facts, and authorized tool profile without changing the wrapper or its hashes.

After provenance identifies the owning generated verification source and exact cause, apply at most a bounded generated-harness or compile-plan repair; preserve the semantic testbench contract and all immutable model/numeric artifacts.
Rerun case_axi_ddr_interface, then run the same board layer with the exact wrapper, current-layer boundary monitors, targeted replay, and CCTG localization before any hardware root-cause edit.

Only after canonical compilation and runtime evidence exist, execute multilayer functional, deadlock, AXI, DDR roundtrip, and board semantic-evidence gates. Promote only if every required gate passes.
Record the retry result and contamination-barrier state in SACG; failed artifacts remain blocked and are not consumed as validated inputs.
risks: Editing spatialacc_exact_board_multilayer_tb.sv or RTL before provenance is complete could repair the wrong declaration, compile-order boundary, or agent-owned source.
Running the current unauthorized compile plan would create untrusted evidence and could contaminate the retry with a different source or tool environment.
A compile failure masks all later runtime causes. Missing progress and output-frontier reports must not be interpreted as a liveness or AXI root cause.
Reusing the weight manifest without executed loader evidence could falsely claim complete DUT weight consumption; only Transformer-block tensors are in scope.
Changing tolerance, checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, golden output, semantic testbench contract, wrapper hash, data order, or memory layout would invalidate the retry rather than repair it.
Repeatedly issuing the same repair without fresh intervention-response evidence risks spinning. The next attempt must produce new provenance, authority-binding, compile, or runtime-trace artifacts.

A board output-frontier symptom in a later run would not by itself reopen the connected kernel. Lower-layer revalidation requires direct current ingress, accepted kernel start, egress-ready, named causal-boundary, and current lower-certificate evidence.

artifacts: sacg_memory_truth active contamination barriers and open retry requests
constraints: Use the exact user-supplied sample wrapper and current source-closure hashes; do not substitute a simplified wrapper.
Bind compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and executables to the current exact Vivado export facts and authorized tool profile.
Keep checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, expected golden, numeric policy and tolerance, and testbench contract immutable.
Do not treat a weight manifest as executed DUT consumption; require a runtime loader report covering every required Transformer-block tensor.
Repair the current board verification layer before promotion; reopen a lower layer only for a current hash-bound trace that explicitly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant.
Preserve elastic variable-latency token-pipeline semantics; unequal stage latency and turnover gaps are not functional failures by themselves.
Exclude embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work from DUT and weight-coverage boundaries.

output.summary: Fail closed at the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system layer. The current board interface/compile contract is invalid and the canonical functional simulation was dependency-skipped. Repair the verification capability and exact board compile-plan bindings, apply only an evidence-bound generated-harness fix if provenance identifies one, then rerun the same board layer with a current-layer targeted replay and boundary trace. Do not promote and do not reopen certified lower layers.
